Plugins_DirectoryOpus_EnableInlineSearch: Allow double-clicking or pressing hotkeys in Directory Opus to summon inline search
Plugins_DirectoryOpus_EnableQuickNavDesc: Allow middle-clicking in Directory Opus's file list to summon the Quick Navigation menu
DirectoryOpus_PluginDesc: Directory Opus integration plugin. Reads active paths and provides quick file location services in Directory Opus.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_DirectoryOpusPathCollec: Reads and collects active folder directory paths from the Directory Opus file manager panels.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_DirectoryOpusInlineSear: Provides inline pinyin/letter filtering and quick navigation for the main lister window of Directory Opus.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_FavoritesProvider: Reads Directory Opus's own Favorites menu from its configuration file and offers it as a Quick Navigation cascade.
